data.import.hint: Whatever is newer in the file wins; the rest stays as it is. Importing the same file again changes nothing.

settings.voice.title: Voice
settings.voice.text: Check what this device can say and understand.
voice.check.title: Voice check
voice.check.intro: See how this device speaks and listens. Say the test phrase and look at the alternatives the browser heard: this shows how well it understands you.
voice.status.speak_no: Speaking out loud: not available in this browser.
voice.status.voices_none: No voice for this language on this device. Texts will show without sound.
voice.status.listen_no: Listening: not available in this browser.
voice.check.no_voice: Could not play: this device has no voice for this language, or the browser blocked the sound.
voice.check.listen_hint: Tap the microphone, say the phrase above (or any other), and wait. Nothing is saved.
voice.check.alternatives: What the browser heard, best first
voice.consent.title: Before you use the microphone
voice.consent.text: When you speak, the audio goes to your browser's speech service (for example Google in Chrome or Apple in Safari), not to Glifora. Glifora never receives or stores your voice. Next, the browser will ask for permission to use the microphone.
voice.nomic.notice: This browser cannot listen to your voice, so you will answer by typing. Everything else works the same.
voice.fail.no_speech: I did not hear anything. Tap the microphone and try again, a little closer.
voice.fail.denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser's site settings, or type your answer instead.
voice.fail.network: The browser's speech service could not be reached. Check your connection, or type your answer instead.
voice.fail.lang: This browser cannot recognize this language. Type your answer instead.
voice.fail.unsupported: This browser cannot listen, or this device has no microphone. Type your answer instead.
voice.test.title: Phrase test
voice.test.intro: Read {n} short English phrases out loud, one at a time. The app checks whether the browser understood each one well enough to pick the right answer, the same way the missions do.
voice.test.privacy: Glifora does not save or send anything: the result only exists on this screen and in the text you choose to copy. Your voice is heard by the browser's speech service, as in the microphone notice.
voice.test.error_missing: The phrases for this test are not available right now. Check your connection and reload.
voice.test.error_invalid: The phrases for this test could not be read.
voice.test.no_listen: This browser cannot listen to your voice, so the phrase test is not available here. Try Chrome on Android.
voice.test.res_broken: This phrase points to an answer that does not exist (content error).
voice.test.text_label: Result text (if copying fails, select it and copy by hand)
voice.test.copied: Copied. Paste it in the conversation.
voice.test.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

play.mode.boss: This is a boss mission: it always starts with no help. You can ask for help along the way without losing anything.

play.done.error: I couldn't save the mission on this device.

settings.ai.title: AI (optional)
settings.ai.text: Use your own free Google key to get an AI review of your report. The whole game works without it.
ai.title: AI (optional)
ai.intro: With a free Google (Gemini) key, the "Review with AI" button in the report corrects what you said and shows a natural way to say your idea. Without a key nothing changes: the game and the report stay the same.
ai.privacy.title: Before you start
ai.privacy.text: On the free quota, Google may use what is sent to improve its products, and people may read it. Do not write personal data in your answers. Glifora sends only the mission lines and what you said (up to 100 characters), without your nickname.
ai.guide.title: How to get the free key (on your phone)
ai.guide.step1: Open aistudio.google.com in your phone browser and sign in with your Google account.
ai.guide.step2: Accept the terms if they appear. Then tap "Get API key".
ai.guide.step3: Tap "Create API key". Pick or create a project just for Glifora.
ai.guide.step4: Tap the key you created and copy it (copy icon). It is a long text of letters and numbers.
ai.guide.step5: Come back here, paste it in the field below and choose where to keep it.
ai.guide.tip: Recommended: create a key just for Glifora. If you ever want to stop, delete only that key in Google AI Studio.
ai.where.title: Where your key stays and where it goes
ai.where.text: The key stays only on this device: in the tab memory (gone when you reload) or, if you ask, saved on this device. It goes straight from your browser to Google (generativelanguage.googleapis.com), never through a Glifora server, and it is not part of your data export. "Delete my key" removes everything.
ai.field.label: Paste your Google (Gemini) key
ai.field.hint: The field is emptied after saving.
ai.save.legend: Where should the key be kept?
ai.save.session.hint: Gone when you reload or close the tab. On a phone, the browser may close the tab by itself.
ai.save.device.hint: Kept here until you delete it. Anyone using this device could use it.
ai.save.invalid: That key does not look right. Copy it again, without spaces.
ai.save.failed: Could not keep it on this device. Choose "This session only".
ai.saved.title: Your key
ai.last.title: Last problem
ai.problem.quota: The free quota for today is used up.
ai.problem.quota.fix: Try again tomorrow. The game and the report stay the same.
ai.problem.credits: The credits or billing on your Google account ran out or expired.
ai.problem.credits.fix: Check the account at aistudio.google.com or use a key from another account.
ai.problem.auth: The key was not accepted: it may be wrong, deleted, revoked or expired.
ai.problem.auth.fix: Create a new key at aistudio.google.com and paste it in Settings, AI (optional).
ai.problem.model: The AI model is not available on your account right now.
ai.problem.model.fix: Try again later. The game stays the same.
ai.problem.region: Google does not serve your region with this key.
ai.problem.region.fix: Without AI, the game and the report stay the same.
ai.problem.timeout: The AI took too long to answer.
ai.problem.refused: The AI did not want to answer this request.
ai.problem.refused.fix: Carry on without the review; the report is already complete.
ai.problem.invalid_output: The AI did not answer properly.
ai.problem.invalid_output.fix: Tap again. If it repeats, carry on without the review.
ai.problem.server: The Google service is having trouble.
ai.problem.no_key: There is no saved key yet.
ai.problem.no_key.fix: Paste your key in Settings, AI (optional).
ai.problem.unknown: Something went wrong with the AI.
ai.problem.unknown.fix: Try again. The game stays the same.
report.ai.title: AI review
report.ai.running: The AI is reading what you said...
report.ai.nokey: Want an AI review? Set up your free key.
report.ai.note: The review is only a help and does not change XP or stars. It lasts only while this tab is open.
report.ai.none: The AI found nothing to review.
